blocks.text: FORENSIC ACCOUNTING, ACCOUNTING, TAXATION & ADVISORY SERVICES

Double Pillars Holding (Proprietary) Limited is a Botswana registered company incorporated in 2014 (BW00000094251) under the Botswana Companies Act to pursue the business of providing professional services to corporates and individuals in Botswana and the region in general. The company carries business under the trading name Double Pillars Consultants with its head office in Gaborone.

The firm specializes in Forensic Accounting, Financial and Management Accounting, Business advisory services, tax and tax planning, and corporate secretarial services. The firm is registered and recognized as a practicing member firm with the Botswana Institute of Chartered Accountants (BICA), with registration no. MeFBW16028. BICA is the body that regulates the accounting and auditing profession in Botswana.

We offer a range of proactive and reactive forensic services which includes the following:
Business (e.g. profiling and pre-vendor due diligence)

Development of anti-fraud policies and codes of conduct
Preparation of claims (insurance, breach of contract and business interruption claims)
Assessment, monitoring and review of fraud and anti-corruption policies and programmes
Filling of annual returns for companies

We are Certified Forensic Investigation professionals with many years of experience in the field of forensic accounting, auditing and investigations.

Corporate fraud is on the rise. Fraud is deception, deliberately practiced in order to secure unfair or unlawful gain. Companies today do not just face risks from internal fraud but also from external criminals who are technologically savvy. The important role of forensic accounting plays in minimizing financials losses through fraud is fast gaining ground. Forensic accounting is the use of accounting, auditing, and investigative skills to assist in legal matters. It encompasses litigation support, investigation and dispute resolution.
We are professionals who use a unique blend of education and experience to apply accounting, auditing and investigative skills to uncover truth, form legal opinions, and assist in investigations.

All our financial statements are prepared using accounts preparation software called "case ware" this allows us to ensure that the financials are compliant with latest accounting standards and complient with IFRS either for SME's or full IFRS.

We are here to help you resolve your tax difficulties and put to tax-induced misery. We pride ourselves on being very efficient, affordable and of course, utterly confidential. It may take the tax authorities several years to catch up to you, but they are relentless and have no mercy in collecting all the money that is owed. when the collection process starts, they can make your life miserable. We are required to enroll in an average of 40 hours per year of continuing professional education and meet this requirement with high quality coursework.

Grow and preserve assets by keeping Uncle Sam out of your pockets.
Reduce taxes on your income so you keep more of what you make.

Remember, we work for you, not for the tax man. Many of our clients save many times the fee in reduced tax liability through careful planning and legitimate tax strategies.

We often encounter groups or companies that, due to the ad-hoc nature of their evolution, suffer an irrelevant or even cumbersome corporate structure. The proliferation of companies within a group often leads to inefficiencies and needless expense. For example, copious statutory returns, undue demands upon management and treasury and the inability to set losses off against profits can draw heavily on any groups human and financial resources. We deliver an expert service in the restructuring of corporate groups in order to maximize efficiency. We are particularly skilled in utilizing the complex ‘corporate rules’ to affect restructuring without creating CGT and income tax exposures.

Supply chain management and project management
